title: Bring an atlas to a librarian beside a rolling ladder

verification_methodology.disclosure: Uses native BEHAVIOR-1K ladder (axywzt) runtime bindings mounted along an upper library shelf rail, native Genie large-format atlas (photo_books/book2), shelves, and Rocketbox librarian. The rolling ladder glides on a real MuJoCo prismatic rail joint pushed by the librarian along the identical trajectory in both branches; Fetch holds the free-body atlas on its arm/tray and either approaches from the clear far side of the settled ladder or docks inside the ladder's swept rail corridor.
